scope: All recorded scored benchmark question families: full source MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, GPQA, TruthfulQA, BBQ, ETHICS and FaithEval; conservative full MATH-500/AIME frame; retained input fields from all available historical JSON/JSONL artifacts, including archived experiments and decoded retained GPT2/C4 contexts. Full-source inclusion is not a claim that every source row was actually used. Discarded unsaved C4 screening inputs and unavailable unrecorded prompts are not reconstructed; pretraining contamination and nonlexical paraphrases remain unexcluded.
